text: {"original_span": "The three-seed sample is small, and the standard error of 0.07 is estimated from those same three runs, so it should be read as a rough indication of spread rather than a tight interval.", "new_span": "The standard error of 0.07, estimated across the three runs, is small enough to confirm that PGR is reliably above 0.5 for this configuration.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "Turns a caveat about a tiny three-seed spread estimate into an unsupported significance claim."}
